description: Defines singleton pattern classes and templates for managing singleton instances, including thread-safe creation, destruction, and proxy handling.

classes.name: Singleton
classes.description: Abstract base class for singleton pattern, manages registration and disposal of singleton instances.

classes.name: SingletonType
classes.description: Template class implementing thread-safe singleton with optional parameterized construction.

classes.name: SingletonProxyType
classes.description: Template class providing singleton proxy with reference counting.

classes.name: UniqueType
classes.description: Template class managing a singleton with reference counting and thread safety.

methods.name: ImplementationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the singleton implementation.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance, with overloads for parameterized creation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the singleton instance with optional parameters.

methods.name: Drop
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes singleton if no longer used.
